findings.message: Implemented as a Camunda user task (zeebe:userTask).
Camunda 8 has no loop cardinality ("${3}"); a multi-instance activity iterates over a collection.
findings.suggestion: Set zeebe:loopCharacteristics inputCollection, e.g. "=for i in 1..n return i" when n ≥ 1.
